content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application form from website www.echs.gov.in. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of education qualification and work experiences. Submit application in duplicate to OIC ECHS Cell, Stn HQ Bhuj by 10 Nov 2026 at 14:00 hours.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Dental Officer, 1 Dental Hygienist/ Dental Asst OR Dental Technical, 1 Lab Tech.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.echs.gov.in) and send it to OIC ECHS Cell, Stn HQ Bhuj, by by hand or post to oic echs cell, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 95,000 for Dental Officer, 36,500 for Dental Hygienist/ Dental Asst OR Dental Technical, 36,500 for Lab Tech.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BDS, Diploma in Dental Hygiene / DORA Course, B.Sc (Medical Lab Tech) / DMLT with experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference will be given to the Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Any application received after 10 Nov 2026 at 14:00 (hrs) will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application screening. 10 days on the Job Training (OJT). Interview. Candidates must reach at Stn HQ, ECHS Cell, Bhuj at 0900hr on 12 Nov 2026 for the interview to be held at 1000hr.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contractual basis for a period of one year renewable for additional period of one year / till attaining the maximum age.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bhuj (Kutch).
